name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for window frame repair?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for window frame repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for window frame repair, prioritize experience, especially with your specific frame material (e.g., wood, vinyl). Look for contractors with a strong portfolio of successful repairs, positive customer reviews, and proper licensing and insurance. A good contractor will offer a clear, detailed estimate, explain the repair process thoroughly, and provide warranties for their work. Local knowledge, particularly in areas like San Bruno or South San Francisco, can also be beneficial.
